content_data.email_purpose: Provide technical update on the integration architecture for the new cross-platform multiplayer backend system and request feedback on proposed API gateway design.
key_points: Identified performance bottleneck in current WebSocket implementation affecting real-time player synchronization
Completed initial API gateway design using Kong for managing third-party game engine integrations
Security audit revealed need for additional rate limiting and OAuth2 token refresh logic in authentication service
content_data.call_to_action: Please review the attached architecture diagrams and provide feedback on the proposed gRPC migration approach by end of next week so we can finalize the technical specification.
